content: Yen biru Yinni Gusunɔ u Nɑtɑni ɡɔrɑ Dɑfidin mi. Ye u turɑ, mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɔmbu yiru ɡɑbɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu teu sɔɔ. Turo sɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡii. Turo mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑro.
Ben wi u sɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡii mi, u yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛbɑ mɔ dɑbi dɑbinu.

Adɑmɑ sɑ̃ɑro wi, u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu mɔ mɑ n kun mɔ yɑ̃ɑ niu piibu ɡɑɡu ɡe u dwɑ. U ɡu nɔɔrimɔ mɑ ɡɑ kpɛ̃ɑmɔ kɑ win bibu sɑnnu. Dĩɑ ni durɔ wi, u rɑ di, niyɑ u rɑ yɑ̃ɑ buu ɡe wɛ̃. Kɑɑ te u rɑ kɑ nim nɔ, terɑ u rɑ mɑɑ kɑ ɡu nim kɛ̃. Kpɑ ɡɑ n kpĩ win tororu wɔllɔ. U yɑ̃ɑ buu ɡe mɛɛrɑwɑ nɡe win bii wɔndiɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru ɡobiɡii wi, u sɔɔ wɑ. Ye u kĩ u nùn yɑɑrɛ ko, yerɑ u ǹ wɑ win sɑbe dɑbi te sɔɔ, ye u koo wunɑ u ɡo sere sɑ̃ɑro win yɑ̃ɑ buu teu ɡe. Gerɑ u mwɑ u kɑ win sɔɔ yɑɑrɛ kuɑ.

Ye Dɑfidi u ɡɑri yi nuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ win mɔru seewɑ ɡem ɡem ye durɔ wi, u kuɑ min sɔ̃. Mɑ u Nɑtɑni sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, n weenɛwɑ durɔ wi, u yɑ̃ɑ buu ɡen sɑkɑ nnɛ kɔsiɑ kpɑ bu durɔ win tii ɡo. Domi u ǹ sɑ̃ɑro win wɔnwɔndu kue.
Mɑ Nɑtɑni u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe durɔ wi. Tɛ̃ wee ye Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u nun bɑndun ɡum tɑ̃re ɑ kɑ kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ. Mɑ u nun wɔrɑ Sɔɔlun nɔmɑn di.
Yen biru u nun wunɛn yinni Sɔɔlun yɛnu wɛ̃ kɑ win kurɔbu kɑ sere mɑɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn bweseru. Ù kun yɛ̃ mɑ yeni yɑ turɑ u n dɑɑ nun sosie.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ win ɡɑri ɑtɑfiiru kuɑ ɑ kɑ kuɑ ye n sɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sɑ win nɔni sɔɔ. A derɑ Amɔnibɑ bɑ Uri Hɛti wi ɡo kɑ tɑkobi, mɑ ɑ win kurɔ suɑ ɑ tii koosi.
Yen sɔ̃, tɑbu kun mɑɑ kpeemɔ wunɛn yɛnuɔ, domi ɑ nùn ɡɛmɑ mɑ ɑ Uri Hɛtin kurɔ wɔrɑ ɑ kuɑ wunɛɡii.
U kpɑm nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ u koo de kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑɑ yu se wunɛn bweseru sɔɔn di yu nun deemɑ. Yerɑ u koo de wunɛn bweserun ɡoo u wunɛn kurɔbu suɑ u kɑ kpunɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ɡbɑ̃ɑrɑ.
Wunɛ ɑ rɑɑ kɑ Urin kurɔ kpunɑwɑ ɡbɛnum, ɑdɑmɑ u koo de yɛ̃ro wi, u kɑ wunɛɡibu kpunɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron wuswɑɑɔ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Nɑtɑni sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn torɑ te, tɑ kpɑ̃ te nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kuɑ. Nɑtɑni u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nun wunɛn durum suuru kuɑ. A ǹ mɑɑ ɡbimɔ.
Adɑmɑ ye ɑ kuɑ mi, yɑ derɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ win yĩsiru ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusi. Yen sɔ̃, u koo de bii wi kurɔ wi, u kɑ nun mɑrɑ mi, u ɡbi.
Ye Nɑtɑni u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, u ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ win yɛnuɔ. Dɑfidin biin ɡɔɔ Yen biru Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ bii wi Dɑfidi u kɑ Urin kurɔ Bɑti Sebɑ mɑrɑ u bɑrɑ ɡem ɡem.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u Gusunɔ kɑnɑru wɔri u nɔɔ bɔkuɑ bii win sɔ̃. Mɑ u duɑ dirɔ u kpunɑ temɔ wɔ̃ku ɡiriru.
Win bwɑ̃ɑbun ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ u kɑ se tem sɔɔn di, ɑdɑmɑ u yinɑ. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ yinɑ u ɡɑ̃ɑnu di.

Ye n kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruse, yerɑ bii wi, u ɡu. Mɑ Dɑfidin bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ bɛrum bɑrɑ bu nùn sɔ̃. Domi bɑ nɛɛ, u ǹ sun swɑɑ dɑki nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ bii wi, u bɑrɔ. Amɔnɑ sɑ ko koosinɑ tɛ̃ su kɑ nùn bii win ɡɔɔ sɔ̃ kpɑ sɑ kun kɑ win nuki sɑnkɑ sɑ sosi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Dɑfidi u wɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ ɡunnu ɡunnu ɡɑri mɔ̀, u ɡiɑ mɑ bii wi, u ɡuwɑ. Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bii wi, u ɡuwɑ? Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, oo, u ɡu.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ tem di u dɑ u woburɑ u win yɑ̃nu kɔsɑ, mɑ u tii turɑre yɛ̃kɑ u dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u nùn sɑ̃wɑ. Yen biru u ɡɔsirɑmɑ yɛnuɔ u dĩɑnu bikiɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn wɛ̃ u di.
Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, mbɑ wunɛn kookoo sin tubusiɑnu. Domi sɑnɑm mɛ bii wi, u wɑsi, ɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑ mɑ ɑ swĩ. Adɑmɑ tɛ̃ ye u ɡu, mɑ ɑ seewɑ ɑ di.
U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, sɑɑ ye bii wi, u wɑsi, nɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑ nɑ swĩ, domi nɑ ǹ yɛ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ ù n koo nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑ kpɑ u bii wi bɛkiɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɛ̃ u ɡu. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ko nɑ n mɑɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑ. Kon kpĩ n nùn seeyɑ ɡɔrin di? Nɛnɑ kon dɑ n nùn deemɑ mi u wɑ̃ɑ. N ǹ mɑɑ wi, u koo wurɑmɑ nɛn mi.
Sɑlomɔɔn mɑrubu
Yen biru Dɑfidi u dɑ u win kurɔ Bɑti Sebɑ nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ, mɑ u kɑ nùn mɛnnɑ. Kurɔ wi, u ɡurɑ suɑ u mɑrɑ bii tɔn durɔ. Mɑ Dɑfidi u nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Sɑlomɔɔ. Yinni Gusunɔ u bii wi kĩɑ ɡem ɡem.
Mɑ u win sɔmɔ Nɑtɑni ɡɔrɑ u mɑɑ nùn yĩsiru ɡɑru kɛ̃ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yedidiɑ. Yen tubusiɑnɑ, wi Yinni Gusunɔ u kĩ.
Dɑfidi u Rɑbɑ mwɑ
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Yoɑbu u Amɔnibɑn wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Rɑbɑ wɔri u ɡen wɔɔ berɑ mwɑ mi ben sinɑ boko u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Yerɑ u Dɑfidi sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, wee, nɑ Rɑbɑn berɑ mi nim mu wɑ̃ɑ mwɑ kɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ tɔn be bɑ tie mɛnnɔ kpɑ i nɑ i wuu ɡe mwɑ mɑm mɑm. Domi nɑ ǹ kĩ bu nɛɛ, nɛ Yoɑbuwɑ nɑ ɡu mwɑ.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u tɔn be kpuro mɛnnɑ, mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Rɑbɑ wɔri bɑ ye mwɑ.

Mɑ u wuu min sunɔn furɔ wurɑɡuu mwɑ. Gen bunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ kilo tɛnɑ kɑ nnɛ. Bɑ ɡu kpee ɡobiɡinu ɡore. Mɑ bɑ ɡu suɑ bɑ Dɑfidi dokeɑ wirɔ. Yen biru u kɑ ɡu dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Yen dɔmɑ te, dukiɑ bɑkɑ Dɑfidi u ɡurɑ.

Mɑ u Rɑbɑn tɔn be bɑ tie yoo sɔmɑ koosiɑ. Ben ɡɑbɑ dɑ̃ɑ bɔɔrimɔ kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ, ɡɑbu kɑ sii, ɡɑbɑ tem ɡbemɔ kɑ dɑ̃kuru, mɑ ɡɑbɑ birikibɑ mɔ̀. Nɡe mɛyɑ u Amɔnibɑn wusu kpuron tɔmbu yoo sɔmɑ kpɛ̃ɛ. Yen biru u ɡɔsirɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ kɑ win tɔmbu kpuro.
